text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even after running 2,400 meters, I'm not 
nearly as tired as I thought I'd be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It looks like I've grown quite a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It seems stamina has become another 
powerful weapon in your arsenal alongside 
your speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With this... I can take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
3,600 meters... To the longest stage of 
all...!
